decision: Product wow_window_client_try_get_long rejects negative indices before _GetWindowLong. GWL_WNDPROC, WOW words and ordinary negative indices then select their own authoritative providers in wow_user_private_access.c. Simply restoring the original negative call makes the product link fail LNK2019. Restoring the helper bodies also requires absent USER dispatch tables. The native dialog reader must use the same HWND slot as the writer; original local slot bodies retained for local-view builds. Compare P164 setter evidence.
